role_gap_evidence: TEST-APPARATUS ROLE-MISMATCH (answers BUILD point 1c — why no existing fitness caught the org.ts BYPASSRLS bug): ci/checks/db/cross_tenant.test.ts (the 152-FZ isolation gate) proves RLS isolation through appUrl() = choros_app (NOBYPASSRLS), while the runtime HTTP read path (getOrgPool → GET /api/org, /api/users) connects via DATABASE_URL = choros_migrator (BYPASSRLS). The fitness apparatus exercises RLS via the app role but NEVER exercises the actual runtime pool role for the read endpoints. RLS policies were correct; the runtime simply bypassed them. The cross-tenant fitness therefore structurally cannot catch a missing explicit WHERE tenant_id on a migrator-pool read — exactly the gap T-0141 patched in org.ts. Candidate remediation: a fitness that runs the read endpoints under the migrator pool and asserts isolation, OR migrate read endpoints to choros_app per T-0022.

RESIDUAL BYPASSRLS-CLASS READ (answers BUILD point 1a): after T-0141, the ONLY remaining tenant-scoped read on the migrator (BYPASSRLS) pool that relies solely on the GUC (no explicit WHERE tenant_id) is queryGrantTrail in src/db/audit-grant-trail.ts (audit_event), reached via /api/audit/grant-trail (src/http/grant-trail.ts, getOrgPool). It is not cross-tenant-exploitable through the showcase persona path (tenantId hardcoded to DEV_TENANT_ID there), and is out of T-0141 scope. Should be closed in a follow-up alongside R-1 (either explicit predicate or choros_app pool migration).

CROSS-TENANT BOOTSTRAP AUTHORITY (T-0140 design, observed not introduced by T-0141): seed-write POST/DELETE handlers gate on loadAdminContext(pool, DEV_TENANT_ID, actorId) — i.e. genesis-ownership of the DEV silo authorizes writes into ANY tenant's body.tenant_id on the BYPASSRLS migrator pool. This is what lets `seed apply/reset --tenant showcase` succeed as devUser=e-owner even though e-owner is not a member/owner of the showcase tenant. Pre-existing T-0140 decision; flagged for awareness because it is a real cross-tenant write authority that will need re-gating when the pool splits to choros_app / Keycloak lands (T-0054/T-0022).
